sources.entry: MaxVideoAI - Multi-engine AI video generation hub (Sora, Veo, Wan, Kling, LTX…).

summary.name: MaxVideoAI
summary.one_liner: MaxVideoAI is a pay-as-you-go AI video generation hub that brings several third-party AI video models (including Seedance, Kling, Veo, LTX, Wan and Pika) into one workspace.
use_cases: Comparing AI video models before generating a clip
Animating a still image such as a character, landscape or product photo
Generating a short video from a text description
Browsing AI video prompt examples and outputs by model
Paying per generation without a subscription to each model
summary.what_it_does: The page describes MaxVideoAI as a workspace that gathers several AI video models so users can compare them without subscribing to each one. Users can generate from text, from an imported or created starting image, or from an existing clip where the chosen model supports video input. The price is shown before generation and depends on model, duration, resolution, and audio or reference inputs. An examples gallery lists prompts and real outputs labelled by model. The page states that failed generations are automatically recredited, while completed results that do not meet expectations are not.
notable: Multi-engine hub: compare Seedance, Kling, Veo, LTX, Wan, Pika and others in one place
Pay-as-you-go credits with price shown before each generation, no subscription
Automatic recredit for technical failed generations
Examples gallery with real outputs and prompts per model
caveats: Available settings such as duration, resolution, audio and reference support vary by model and generation mode
Results are not guaranteed to be reproducible from the same prompt
Completed results that do not match expectations are not refunded or recredited
